title: Tee Higgins "trying to shoot" for first 1,000-yard season since 2022

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tee Higgins "trying to shoot" for first 1,000-yard season since 2022
sources.description: Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins had his second straight double-digit touchdown season in 2025, but he fell short of another individual goal for the third straight year.
